explainer.heading: A light hydrating step that comes before moisturiser
body: After a peel, or on days when skin is dry, the outer layer holds water poorly. What skin needs then is a hydrating, soothing step, followed by a moisturiser to hold it in.
The B5 ampoule is that hydrating step. Glycerin, panthenol and hyaluronic acid are familiar humectants, and all three sit within the first eight ingredients.
It does not replace moisturiser and does not replace sunscreen. The manufacturer's instructions follow it with the Collagen moisturiser.

blocks.heading: When it fits, and when to wait
blocks.intro: Compare your skin with the intended use in the notification dossier: soothing, hydrating, keeping moisture in.

items.label: Dry, tight, short of moisture

image.alt: Close-up of dehydrated skin with a rough surface and visible pores

items.body: The dossier lists hydrating and keeping skin soft and smooth. Apply after cleansing, then use a moisturiser to hold the moisture in.

items.label: Flushed from dryness

image.alt: Close-up of a flushed cheek with small bumps

items.body: The dossier lists soothing and reducing redness caused by dryness. If skin stings, breaks out in bumps or the redness spreads, that is irritation. Remove steps first rather than adding one.
items.fitNote: If the redness is from dryness, not irritation

items.label: Using the Mocha peel kit
items.body: The recovery ampoule in the Retinol mixPEEL kit is this product. Follow the schedule that comes with the kit, and buy a single ampoule when you need another.

items.label: Just had a cosmetic procedure

image.alt: Close-up of reddened skin after a cosmetic procedure

items.body: Ask the practitioner who did the procedure before you apply anything. With their go-ahead, this is a hydrating step; it does not replace your moisturiser.

items.label: Melasma, dark marks, uneven tone

image.alt: Close-up of a cheekbone with diffuse sun-related darkening

items.body: The intended use in the dossier says nothing about pigment. If you want to fade dark marks, you need a different product in the range.

items.label: Broken, weeping or burnt skin
items.body: Do not apply it to open or damaged skin. That needs a doctor.

blocks.heading: Ingredients as listed in the notification dossier
blocks.intro: The dossier lists all 47 ingredients by INCI name. The table below explains the ones worth knowing.
blocks.caption: Full list from the notification dossier: Aqua, Glycerin, Propanediol, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Cetearyl Alcohol, Panthenol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Hyaluronic Acid, Lecithin, Acetyl Glutamine, Sh-Oligopeptide-1, Sh-Oligopeptide-2, Sh-Polypeptide-1, Sh-Polypeptide-9, Sh-Polypeptide-11, Bacillus/Folic Acid Ferment Filtrate Extract, Sodium Hyaluronate, Centella Asiatica Extract, Sea Water, Laminaria Digitata Extract, Chlorella Vulgaris Extract, Saccharide Isomerate, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Glyceryl Stearate, Cyclopentasiloxane, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Ascorbic Acid, Biotin, Thiamine HCl, Cyanocobalamin, Glutathione, Ceteareth-20, Ceteareth-12, Caprylyl Glycol, Butylene Glycol, Riboflavin, Pyridoxine, Folic Acid, Menadione, Bioflavonoids, 1,2-Hexanediol, Cetyl Palmitate, Disodium EDTA, Fragrance, Triethanolamine. The dossier gives a percentage only for the two ingredients with concentration limits: phenoxyethanol 0.5% and triethanolamine 0.1%.

rows.name: Panthenol (pro-vitamin B5)
rows.role: Holds moisture and eases the tight, dry feeling. Sixth in the list.

rows.name: Glycerin
rows.role: A humectant, second in the list, right after water.

rows.name: Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate
rows.role: Hold water in the outer layer of the skin. They appear at positions 8 and 17.

rows.name: Centella Asiatica Extract, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate
rows.role: Centella extract and a liquorice derivative, both in the soothing group.

rows.name: Sh-Oligopeptide-1, Sh-Oligopeptide-2, Sh-Polypeptide-1, Sh-Polypeptide-9, Sh-Polypeptide-11
rows.role: Five synthetic peptides, used as conditioning ingredients.

rows.name: Tocopheryl Acetate, Ascorbic Acid and B vitamins
rows.role: Vitamin E, vitamin C and vitamins B1, B2, B6, B7, B9 and B12, used as conditioning ingredients. Most sit in the second half of the list.

rows.name: Sea Water, Laminaria Digitata Extract, Chlorella Vulgaris Extract
rows.role: Sea water, kelp extract and green algae extract.

rows.name: Fragrance
rows.role: Added scent, at position 46. If scent bothers your skin, patch-test on a small area first.

blocks.heading: After cleansing, before moisturiser
blocks.intro: The steps follow the manufacturer's instructions.

items.heading: Cleanse
items.body: Wash your face and pat dry. During a peel, rinse the peel off with water first.

items.heading: Take enough to cover the face
items.body: Spread it evenly over the whole face.

items.heading: Massage gently
items.body: Massage lightly with your fingers so the serum spreads and sinks in evenly.

items.heading: Follow with moisturiser
items.body: The manufacturer's instructions follow it with the Collagen moisturiser. In the daytime, finish with sunscreen.

blocks.footnote: If you are using the Retinol mixPEEL kit, follow the schedule that comes with the kit. If burning lasts, or you get swelling, blistering or pain, stop every step and see a doctor.
